description: This file defines a REST API resource for self-authentication within the Fineract project. It sets up an endpoint '/v1/self/authentication' that authenticates provided credentials and returns roles and permissions, utilizing annotations for API documentation, request handling, and conditional bean loading.

classes.name: SelfAuthenticationApiResource
classes.description: A REST controller class that provides an endpoint for self-authentication, wrapped with Spring and Fineract-specific annotations for conditional registration and API documentation.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Handles POST requests to authenticate user credentials, returning a JSON response with roles and permissions.
